outcome: incidence of vaginal births within 12 and 24 hours
cohort: 100 nulliparous women at more than 40 weeks of gestation with an unfavourable cervix and no pregnancy complications
finding: Vaginally administered misoprostol resulted in a shorter induction to delivery interval and a higher incidence of vaginal births within 12 and 24 hours compared to vaginally administered dinoprostone.
mod_finding: Women in the misoprostol group had a lower rate of caesarean section compared to those in the dinoprostone group.
